patch: if m["n"] >= SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES and m["var"] > 1e-6: -> if m["n"] > SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES and m["var"] > 1e-6:
machine: box D3-g07: nproc 4, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 16 GB; wall/CPU/load provisional

probe.inputs_tried: 30 sunny folds, irradiance 200..780 W/m2 in 20 W/m2 steps, residual = 1.5x modelled solar gain; null 29 folds; 31 folds (both arms move)

should_fail: tests/features.py (the only closure script whose traced baseline executes coordinator.py:9402) has no check that the solar-aperture scale moves off 1.0 on exactly the SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES-th varying sunny fold

finding.title: No check pins the solar-aperture learner's first correction at exactly SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES folds
finding.claim: Mutating coordinator.py:9402 `m["n"] >= SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES` to `>` delays the solar-aperture scale's first correction by one fold (scale 2.0 -> 1.0 after 30 folds) and the full GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift gate stays green.
finding.metric_definition: _solar_aperture['scale'] after exactly 30 varying sunny-step folds of _fold_solar_aperture (ratio)
finding.evidence_command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/fullgate.py run --src complete --key d3cad40ffce9b765  (gate: RED-AS-NULL); PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub /opt/hpo/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/wave/D3-g07/probes/probe_d3cad40ffce9b765.py  (scale_baseline_at_min=2.000000, scale_mutant_at_min=1.000000)

perturbation.change: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:9402 `if m["n"] >= SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES and m["var"] > 1e-6:` -> `if m["n"] > SOLAR_APERTURE_MIN_SAMPLES and m["var"] > 1e-6:` (applied in memory by the probe; on disk by fullgate.py for the gate)
